name: scribe
description: Professional documentation structure, writing, and technical visual skills with one guided entry point.

interface.shortDescription: Structure and write clear professional documents.
interface.longDescription: Plan general and domain-specific documentation structures, then create domain knowledge sets, essence articles, knowledge documents, PRDs, reusable architecture studies, delivery architecture, and technical diagrams through focused, composable skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $ask-scribe to explain which Scribe skills fit my task and how to combine them.
Use $structure-docs and $write-doc to plan a clear directory and file structure for this documentation set.
Use $structure-domain-docs, $structure-docs, and $write-doc to create a coherent directory and reading path for this domain knowledge set.
Use $write-domain-doc and $write-doc to create the appropriate document for this domain directory.
Use $write-domain-doc and $write-doc to write a first-principles essence article for this domain.
Use $write-doc to draft a clear technical document from these notes.
Use $draw-diagrams and $write-doc to turn this architecture into a concise diagram.
